notes.title: Update 1.91 - Combat Fixes -
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Tempus Deusies![/b]

It's been a long time since I updated lords & Blades and that's because I've been busy making it as good as I can. I have heard all the criticisms and am working hard to try and make the game as good as I can. With this, I have a large update! This hopefully makes the game more playable, fun and stable.

First of all, we got a bunch of fixes.

Fixes

- Tera's Quest fix, now it cannot be completed before taking the quest.
- Fixes two achievements not triggering
- Reworked melee attack sound and feedback design, added new sounds and physical effects upon succesfull hits, also added ''Break'' system to ''break'' positioning and stun them.
- Mithrill sword changed to correct weapon model
- Small Buckler changed to correct weapon model
- Increased price of Steel Sword and decreased it's damage by 3 (52)
- Decreased damage of Warhammer by 5 (49)
- Decreased Archer's Buckler's melee attack speed from 0.1 to 0.05

Then, we have a bunch of new features and additions.

Added

- Added more achievements
- Reworked the Endgame, now reachable by talking to Harry the Priest after Cellius.
- Reworked Abyssal Veil, its now an Island called; Emerald Isle
- Reworked Options Menu
- Added options menu in the inventory
- Reworked the inventory setup to look a bit better
- Added ''Break'' system in melee combat
- Added New quest after Tyrus, talk to Harry after Cellius's defeat for more info. (No spoilers here!)
- Added a new achievement for this quest.
- Added a new NPC in Esway's Refuge (Sven)
- Added a feature where NPC's change their opinion of you based on in-game actions
- Overhauled Glanceria, got rid of the slums and placed new buildings with new NPC's.


Lords & Blades is the kind of game I always wanted to make. Unfortunately, I have released it a tad bit too early, assuming that everyone would love it as much as I did. Ofcourse, we have people who do for
whom I am ever gratefull, but I also see now the criticisms and hopefully with this massive update the game will be much better!

Thanks for all the amazing support.

Sentinel Studios

notes.title: Lords & Blades, Release Update 1.8
notes.notes:
The final update for the release next week saturday 01-02-2025. 

Fixed/added:

- Credits button in Main Menu.
- More updated settings with keybinds, music sound slider and resolution options.
- Home teleport button in main menu to be able to unstuck yourself without reloading and losing progress.

notes.title: Lords & Blades, Pre-release update 1.7
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Tempeus Deusies![/b]

Today, we have a major update for you guys. With many changes and fixes. New bosses, new items and much more. See the full update list below. We quickly want to also mention that the 1st of February 2025 we will fully release Lords & Blades, so expect many more updates. We also did a bunch of checking with fans and reddit to get some honest feedback, and we have taken that to heart and changed a bunch of things accordingly, such as the XP bar.

Update 1.7

Added:

- Changed Exarc the damned boss fight, now it's a Barbarian with a cutscene. The boss teleports all around while you fight it.
- New Boss for end of the game, ''Herald of Cellius'' together with 2 other enemies. Instead of just a random big knight with no health bar/music.
- Added 3 houses to Glanceria, plus another NPC that sells goods.
- Added total of 3 new items ; Epic weapon, Rare Emulet and new consumable.
- Added Chapel to Esway's Refuge
- Added Priest Harry to Esway's Refuge, at a certain level threshold he will give you a magical ability.
- Added magical ability : Godly Wrath, dealing 250-350 damage in a small AoE, with 30 second cooldown.
- Added Blacksmith to Esway's Refuge with a blacksmith NPC that sells all the weapons.
- Added a few more enemies here and there
- Added new room in End game Castle (Taergoria's Keep) with moving walls puzzle room and 2 new chests.
- Reworked some of the nature landscaping, making it look better.
- Extended Exarc's Keep to hold the new boss fight room



Fixed:

- All enemies are now targetable with ''Tab'' and or Middle Mouse Button. (For controllers Thumbstick button)
- Moved XP bar under health bar.
- Several spelling mistakes.
- Made XP bar smaller.
- Made Minimap more clear, and smaller.
- Fixed some lightning effects
- Reduced some foliage in distance (LOD) for better performance.
- Fixed music bug in Exarc the Damned Boss fight
- Reduced health of Demaecans from 1200 to 900
- Reduced health of Chest Protector Mage from 10000 to 5200
- Increased damage dealt by Exarc the damned boss fight to 83-125
- Fixed house buying achievement in Glanceria
- Fixed ending w/ cellius so it goes a bit faster and is more clear





What we're working on for the next update:

- Death Freeze bug, your character doesnt ragdol right when it is defeated.
- Shop opening bug
- More additions and fixes...

Thanks so much for checking out our game! 

Team Sentinel Studios

notes.title: OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Dear Tempus Deusies,

At the beginning of 2025, We will go out of Early access and into the full release of Lords & Blades. A lot of things will be added and reworked this year. We have done many posts on Reddit and had an extensive player testing phase to check what people really want and we have decided to overhaul the UI, setup a ability system and rework a portion of the overworld map. Minimap will be optional with a menu button and many more small changes that will make the game not only look better but run better and feel more polished. Then, we will release Lords & Blades and start the marketing push. 

Thanks so much for everyone who has tested and played and bought the game in early access, means the world!

Sentinel Studios Team

notes.title: UPDATE 1.10 QUEST UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today, we are releasing the new update 1.10.
There have been many bug fixes, additional content and new features that you guys asked for!


Fixes:

- Fixed the loading bug, where you would lose control of your mouse in the loading screen.
- Fixed some texture bugs and misplaced foiliage.
- Fixed player not saving the current health pool, everytime you would re load the game you would have 100 health. This is now fixed.
- Have NOT fixed achievements yet, will be fixed in the next update


Added:

- New Area, Terjania.
- New NPC area, Clanceria Manor in Terjania. Not yet populated.
- New Enemy in Terjania, Skeleton Giant
- New Enemy in Terjania, Kappa.
- New Helmet in Terjania, Mask of Death.
- New Arrow type; Elven arrow, deals more damage to undead.
- New QUEST SYSTEM, with TWO new quests. Talk to the two NPC's at the Gate of Eswaydan towards the forest.
- Added house system, not yet available to buy.
- Added NEW INTRO CINEMATIC, when you start a new game, the game will start with a intro cinematic with some exposition.
- Added more NPC dialog options, and several NPC's that will talk to you when you pass, this may change depending on your character's level.


More updates coming in the future, post anything you'd like to be added, we wil look at it and maybe it will be added!

thanks again to everyone who is supporting our project!

Darryl
Sentinel Studios
